claim_scope: CPU cross-fit diagnostic of whether past relevance feedback can select persistently useful VLM retrieval pages
research_question: Does historical relevance feedback, used only from past folds, close enough of the future-information oracle gap to justify persistent VLM retrieval-index materialization?

primary_fusion.name: rrf60_top100_fixed_global_visual_rank_oracle
primary_fusion.warning: Full visual ranks remain forbidden to a deployable method; this experiment isolates selection transfer only.

sensitivity_fusion.name: masked_full_corpus_zscore_oracle
sensitivity_fusion.warning: Full-corpus visual calibration remains forbidden; selected-set fusions quantify the deployment gap.

cross_fit.history_role: page selection may use historical qrels as a proxy for clicks or successful-answer feedback
cross_fit.future_role: future qrels and scores are evaluation-only

selection_policies.corpus_uniform: even coverage over stable corpus order
selection_policies.text_risk: lowest text posting bytes; fallback is lowest historical BM25 visibility
selection_policies.history_frequency: historical BM25 Top-100 discounted candidate frequency
selection_policies.cover25_frequency75: 25% text-risk coverage plus historical candidate frequency
selection_policies.history_relevance: historical qrel frequency as a proxy for observed clicks/success, filled by candidate frequency
selection_policies.history_relevance_cover25: 25% text-risk coverage plus historical relevance feedback, filled by candidate frequency
selection_policies.score_oracle: future Full visual Top-100 frequency; forbidden
selection_policies.label_rank_oracle: future qrels plus Full ranks; forbidden optimistic oracle

gain_recovery: (Q_partial - Q_text) / (Q_full_hybrid - Q_text); omit when absolute denominator < 0.005

online_trace.nonpersistent_baseline: Current-query BM25 Top-20 visual rescoring, discarded; DVI-style retrieval proxy only.
online_trace.persistent_baseline: Current-query BM25 Top-20 representations retained; naive selected-set RRF.

audit_gate.realizable_feedback_target: At 20% or 40% pages, historical-feedback selection should recover at least 50% of positive full-hybrid gain in two domains under oracle-fixed calibration.
audit_gate.persistence_boundary: Report exact relevant-page overlap from history to future; zero-overlap workloads favor nonpersistent query-time analysis.

information_boundary.historical_qrels_semantics: Only a proxy for observable feedback; not assumed free in deployment.
